input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for reporting that the bathroom window at Flat 20, 120 Lantern Quay, Northbridge, ZZ8 2ZZ is stuck and won't open (ref R/PM048-1).

The landlord has approved the repair. We are now arranging a contractor and will be in touch to agree an appointment. Please don't force the window in the meantime. Using the extractor fan, if there is one, will help with ventilation until it's fixed.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
